national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh; Highlights PM-SETU Scheme and WorldSkills Asia 2027
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh in Lucknow, emphasizing the 'Shrameva Jayate' principle to strengthen skill development and manufacturing capacity in India.

Highlighted a planned investment of ₹60,000 crore under the PM-SETU scheme to modernise Industrial Training Institute (ITI) infrastructure, upgrade machinery, train instructors, and strengthen industry linkages.

Announced that India will host the WorldSkills Asia competition in Greater Noida in 2027, showcasing youth talent across emerging trades including AI, cybersecurity, green hydrogen, electric vehicles, and robotics.

national_news.title: Bhashini AI Platform Expands Voice Prescription Tool Across Major Public Healthcare Facilities
bullets: Bhashini, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology's (MeitY) AI language platform, expanded its voice prescription tool from a two-department pilot to an institute-wide rollout at AIIMS New Delhi.

The speech-to-text tool has been integrated into the National Informatics Centre's (NIC) eHospital module, JIPMER's e-Sushrut system, and the Indian Army's Dhanwantri system to convert spoken clinical notes into electronic records.

Demonstrated at the Global Digital Health Summit in New Delhi, the tool enables doctors to dictate case histories and prescriptions directly into hospital systems in English and supported Indian languages.

national_news.title: India Holds Bilateral Cultural Talks with Azerbaijan and Tajikistan at SCO Forum
bullets: Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat held bilateral discussions with delegations from Azerbaijan and Tajikistan on the sidelines of the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi.
Key heritage links highlighted include the historic Ateshgah Fire Temple near Baku, Azerbaijan, which features Devanagari and Gurmukhi inscriptions.
The discussions also acknowledged the recent inscription of Tajikistan's Sumanak tradition on UNESCO’s Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.

national_news.title: PM Modi Launches Projects Worth ₹34,470 Crore in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated and laid foundation stones for multiple development projects worth ₹34,470 crore in Vaishali, Bihar, covering energy, roads, and urban infrastructure.
Dedicated the 19.7 km long 'Nitish Setu' 6-lane bridge over River Ganga, built at ₹4,280 crore connecting Kachchi Dargah (Patna) to Bidupur (Vaishali).
Inaugurated the 660 MW second unit of the Buxar Thermal Power Project, flagged off 100 PM-eBuses, and performed Griha Pravesh for over 26,900 PMAY-Urban beneficiaries.

national_news.title: NCB and US DEA Bust Illicit Drug Network Under Operation Monsoon Thunder
bullets: India's Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) partnered with the US Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) to execute 'Operation Monsoon Thunder' targeting a transnational illicit drug ring.
The operation dismantled an Indian module illicitly supplying psychotropic and opioid drugs to US consumers via digital platforms like Telegram, WhatsApp, and Google Sheets.
Six individuals were apprehended, around 3,000 illicit parcels were identified, and data of over 59,000 US subjects was shared for enforcement.

national_news.title: 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) Commences in Goa
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) opened at Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Stadium in Goa under the theme 'Stories Without Borders'.
The 9-day festival features over 150 films from 86 countries, showcasing 52 women filmmakers, 62 debut directors, and special showcases from Russia, Spain, and BRICS nations.
Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted state infrastructure goals under the Goa Film Shooting Act, 2021, and single-window clearance mechanisms.

national_news.title: 57th IFFI Features Special Package of 12 Goan Konkani and Marathi Films
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Panaji, Goa curated a special Goan film package showcasing 12 films in Konkani and Marathi.
The selected films cover diverse themes including identity, family relationships, local traditions, and social realities of Goa.
Key titles featured in the package include Manguirish J. Bandodkar’s 'Ancessao', Vardhan Vijaykumar Kamat’s 'Umesh', Prasad M. Naik’s 'Shakuntala', and Kishor Arjun’s Marathi film 'Daryaa'.

national_news.title: Indian Navy Inducts Indigenously Built Diving Support Craft DSC A21
bullets: The Indian Navy received 'DSC A21', an indigenously designed and constructed Diving Support Craft (DSC), at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai.

The catamaran-hull vessel was constructed by Kolkata-based Titagarh Rail Systems Limited (TRSL), with hydrodynamic testing conducted by Naval Science and Technological Laboratory (NSTL), Visakhapatnam.
Built under Indian Register of Shipping (IRS) regulations, the vessel enhances navy capabilities in underwater inspection, diving support, salvage assistance, and coastal operations.

national_news.title: India's Merchandise Exports Expand Across Global Regions in H1 FY27
bullets: India's merchandise exports recorded broad-based regional growth during April–September 2026-27, led by a 44% growth in exports to Africa ($31.42 billion) and 21% growth to Asia ($103.84 billion).
Within Asia, exports to Singapore doubled by 103% to $11.07 billion, while exports to China grew by 36% to reach $11.39 billion.
Exports to the Americas grew 13% to $66.82 billion (led by the US at $50.80 billion), with major growth driven by engineering goods ($27.47B to Asia), petroleum products, and electronic goods.

national_news.title: Ministry of Mines and FICCI Release Framework for Overseas Critical Mineral Investments
bullets: The Ministry of Mines, in collaboration with FICCI, released a concept paper titled 'Enabling Overseas Investment in Critical Minerals' to secure India's strategic mineral supply chains.

The framework focuses on expanding Khanij Bidesh India Limited's (KABIL) overseas operations, establishing a Country-Priority Mineral Matrix, and encouraging extraction of critical minerals from by-products like red mud.
Aligned with the National Critical Mineral Mission, the initiative aims to bolster domestic processing, streamline auction reforms, and enhance global competitiveness through tech-enabled governance.

national_news.title: India Records Strong Regional Merchandise Export Growth in H1 FY27
bullets: During April-September 2026-27, India's merchandise exports recorded highest growth in Africa (44% to $31.42 billion) followed by Asia (21% to $103.84 billion) and Americas (13% to $66.82 billion).
In Asia, China ($11.39 billion) and Singapore ($11.07 billion) were the largest markets, with exports to Singapore registering a growth of 103%.

Major export categories driving growth included engineering goods ($27.47 billion in Asia), petroleum products ($17.05 billion), and electronic goods, which grew by 91% in Asia to reach $10.54 billion.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Dedicated Development Projects Worth ₹34,000 Crore in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for development projects worth around ₹34,000 crore in Vaishali, Bihar.
Key inaugurations include the 19.36 km six-lane Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur 'Nitish Setu' over the Ganga River, constructed at a cost of ₹5,571.69 crore.
Projects also include Unit-2 of the 660 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, a floating solar plant at Phulwaria Dam, 100 PM-e-buses, and housewarming ceremonies for 26,900+ PMAY-U beneficiaries.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's First IT Park to Be Established in Gardanibagh, Patna
bullets: Bihar's first state-of-the-art IT Park is being established in Gardanibagh, Patna, at an estimated cost of ₹413 crore.
The National Buildings Construction Corporation (NBCC) is the designated execution agency, with the project carrying an estimated monetisation value of ₹1,071 crore over a 90-year lease.
The complex will feature a 7-storey five-star hotel for corporate representatives and will be monitored by a committee headed by the IT Department Secretary.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Digital Planetariums Plan & Union MoHUA SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026
bullets: Bihar Science and Technology Department announced 3 new digital planetariums in East Champaran, Jamui, and Purnia costing ₹39 crore under the Ministry of Culture's SPOCS scheme.
Union Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal conferred the SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026 in New Delhi, featuring 52 awards and 5 special recognitions.
Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh were named top overall performers, while Assam, Sikkim, Mizoram, and Tripura led among North-Eastern and Hilly States.

bihar_news.title: CtrlS Datacenters to Invest ₹10,000 Crore in 150 MW AI Facility in Bihar
bullets: CtrlS Datacenters signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Bihar state government to invest ₹10,000 crore to establish a 150 MW hyperscale AI facility.
The proposed AI-ready data center will be located on a 100-acre plot near Patna, aiming for commercial operations by 2029–30.
The project is expected to generate 400 direct jobs, comprising 100 on-site positions and 300 jobs created by hosted customers.

bihar_news.title: Major Infrastructure, Energy, and Highway Projects Launched across Bihar
bullets: Inaugurated Unit 2 (660 MW) of the 1,320-MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, RDSS loss-reduction works worth Rs 1,130 crore, and a floating solar project at Phulwaria Dam in Nawada.

Laid foundation stones for projects worth Rs 14,450 crore, including the four-laning of NH-139W (Sahebganj-Areraj-Bettiah) costing Rs 3,800 crore and power evacuation for the 2,400-MW Pirpainti Super Thermal Power Project (Rs 3,350 crore).
Dedicated the 19.7-km Nitish Setu over the Ganga to relieve traffic pressure on Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu, reducing commute time between North and South Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Union Minister Manjhi Hails Naming of 19.7-km Nitish Setu Bridge over Ganga
bullets: Union Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi welcomed the naming of the 19.7-km Ganga bridge as 'Nitish Setu' in recognition of former CM Nitish Kumar's service.
Built at an estimated cost of Rs 4,280 crore, the extradosed cable-stayed bridge connects Kachhi Dargah (NH-22) in Patna with Bidupur (NH-322) in Vaishali.
The bridge comprises a 9.7-km main structure over the river and 10 km of approach roads, aimed at enhancing connectivity between North and South Bihar.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Launches Key Infrastructure and Educational Initiatives in WB, Bihar, and UP
bullets: At IIT Kharagpur in West Bengal, PM Modi attended the 75th Platinum Jubilee celebrations, unveiled a special commemorative coin, and launched a PG medical course.
In Bihar, the PM dedicated the ₹4,280-crore Nitish Setu and inaugurated development projects valued at ₹34,470 crore covering roads, energy, urban infrastructure, and healthcare.
In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the PM participated in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh, felicitating 52 national-level toppers from ITIs, NSTIs, and IToTs.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister Conducts Multi-State Development Tour Across WB, Bihar, and UP
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched developmental initiatives across West Bengal, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh, focusing on higher education, state infrastructure, and skill development.
Participated in the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of India's first IIT, IIT Kharagpur (established 1951 in West Bengal), interacting with 75 students and unveiling a special commemorative coin.
Felicitated 52 national-level skill toppers from ITIs, NSTIs, and IToTs during the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh held at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.
